# In obs 94, Cabinet 1 and Floor Lamp 1 are both visible!
import cv2, numpy as np
img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0094.png")

# Cabinet doors:

ys, xs = np.where(mask)
print(f"Cabinet doors in obs 94: x=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], width={xs.max()-xs.min()+1}, bottom_y={ys.max()}, center_x={xs.mean():.1f}")

# Lamp base:
mask_lamp = (img[:,:,0] > 70) & (img[:,:,0] < 120) & (img[:,:,1] > 70) & (img[:,:,1] < 120) & (img[:,:,2] > 70) & (img[:,:,2] < 120)
yl, xl = np.where(mask_lamp[:, 350:450])
xl += 350
print(f"Lamp base in obs 94: x=[{xl.min()}, {xl.max()}], width={xl.max()-xl.min()+1}, bottom_y={yl.max()}, center_x={xl.mean():.1f}")
'
